title: SOC 2 Type II Control Requirements
description: Synthetic SOC 2-style requirements for reviewing Acme Corp's IT security policy.

requirements.title: Data retention schedule
requirements.requirement: The organization must maintain a documented data retention schedule that defines retention periods, legal hold handling, secure deletion procedures, and accountable owners by data category.

requirements.title: Current incident response procedures
requirements.requirement: Incident response procedures must reference current communication channels, current severity levels, current roles, and a playbook reviewed within the last 12 months.

requirements.title: Access control review
requirements.requirement: Access to production systems must require MFA, least-privilege roles, and periodic access review.

sections.title: SOC 2 review overview
sections.content: Baseline SOC 2-style expectations covering data retention scheduling, incident response procedure currency, and access control review.
